name: WordPress
about: The newest WordPress release on each recent branch. Each one fixes every WordPress bug we cover.
older: Older branches back to 4.7 also get security releases (for example 6.7.12); 4.6 and older get none. Only the newest version is actively supported, and sites with automatic background updates on get these by themselves.
